verdict.rationale: Docusign's REST API, official Node.js SDK, and public OpenAPI/Swagger specs enable fully programmatic, unattended sending/signing/approving of documents, which is the core requirement for headless/CI automation, and community reports confirm real-world API-driven implementations work (though with documentation friction). Missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline examples, no llms.txt/openapi.json discoverability endpoint (probes show 404s), and no dedicated 'headless mode' or automation quickstart guide.
